title: Test Tools need to be better specced
description:
We want agents from the outside to use TestTools, therefore the schemas and APIs need to be made better so that there's a consistent model to use when interacting with them (input and output).
This also means that all internal usages need to be adapted to this.

features.title: Define Standardized Test Result Types
features.description: Create a new `src/types/TestResult.ts` file and define the `TestResult` and `CoverageResult` interfaces. `TestResult` should contain `status ('pass' | 'fail')`, `stdout`, `stderr`, and `exitCode`. `CoverageResult` should formalize the existing success structure and define a consistent error shape, including fields like `status ('ok' | 'error')`, `message`, and `test` execution details.

features.title: Refactor `runTest` to Return a Standardized JSON Object
features.description: Modify the `runTest` function in `src/tools/TestTools.ts` to return a `Promise<TestResult>`. Update all code paths, including success and error handling, to return a JSON object conforming to the new `TestResult` interface instead of the current formatted string (`PASS`/`FAIL`).

features.title: Refactor `runTestCoverage` for Consistent JSON Output
features.description: Modify the `runTestCoverage` function in `src/tools/TestTools.ts` to return a `Promise<CoverageResult>`. Ensure that all execution paths, especially error conditions, return a JSON object that conforms to the `CoverageResult` interface, eliminating any string-based `FAIL` returns.

features.title: Update Tool Signatures and Descriptions
features.description: In `src/tools/Tools.ts`, update the `toolSigsForAgent` function to change the return type signature for `runTest` from `-> str` to `-> json`. Also, update the `TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS` for `runTest` and `runTestCoverage` to accurately describe their new standardized JSON output.

features.title: Update Project Documentation for TestTools API
features.description: Update the `TestTools` section in `docs/FILE_ORGANISATION.md` to document the new, standardized JSON response schemas for `runTest` and `runTestCoverage`. Provide examples of the success and error JSON objects for clarity.

features.title: There needs to be a function to list all current tests and a subscribe for test file changes
features.description: The api should follow @src/tools/StoryTools.ts or @src/tools/ProjectTools.ts - they behave very similarly in terms of subscribing and listing the available stories / projects. The same needs to be done here.

features.title: TestTools cleanup
features.description: We can assume that all tests for all projects live in './tests' directory and that only tests will be there - so no need to match/check for file patterns.\nInstead of using 2 file watchers we can use just 1 - the indexed version simply does more.

features.title: Follow the patterns other tools used in using utils.ts and FileUtils.ts
features.description: Look at how @src/tools/StoryTools.ts uses @src/files/FileUtils.ts and @src/utils.ts for getting the path and ensuring the directory exists - do the same.

features.title: There needs to be a runTests api
features.description:
In @src/tools/TestTools.ts we need a `runTests` that will run all the tests inside the provided `path` .
We also need an equivalent coverage function (if the one already existing doesn't do that already).

features.title: Update the result of coverage to the new type
features.description:
There's a new type in @src/types.ts - "NewCoverageOkResult" .
This needs to replace the current "CoverageResult".
Essentially the Ok and Error results need to be joined into one and when the result is ok, it should also contain a summary (i.e. an average of all the CoverageFileStats). This needs to be returned now in @src/tools/TestTools.ts .

features.title: There's a new type NewTestResult and TestsResult
features.description: These types are defined in @src/types.ts use them in @src/tools/TestTools.ts to return correct stats per test in NewTestResult and a run down of all tests to return TestsResult from `runTests`

features.title: Test run results need to be augmented with invalidation and stored
features.description:
The `testsRun` and `testsCoverage` results from @src/tools/TestTools.ts  need to be stored under `.factory` in their separate files - only for those two functions and only when running directly in the `tests` folder. 
There needs to be an extra API to be able to retrieve the last results for the tests and coverages (no input is necessary as there should be 1 file each).

features.title: Parsing test results from `vitest` can be better
features.description:
When parsing passing tests only lines of the form:
" ✓ tests/AgentRunTools.test.ts > AgentRunTools > create/list/get/update/rate/delete run "
should be looked at. The "✓" indicates a passing test. Do not parse passing tests from elsewhere.

features.description:

Somehow running coverage works.

features.title: When collecting coverage, filter out files that don't contribute to testing
features.description:
There's some files that seem to have no real code in them - like the @src/index.ts file in this project. They should never be considered for coverage as they end up showing as 100% covered and thus contribute to the overall statistics. @src/tests/TestUtils.ts needs to be improved to do this.
Coverage result should be augmented to include the list of these files that end up getting ignored.

features.title: Allow running other tests
features.description:
A different project using this package has vitests that can be run normally via `vitest run` but they also have a more complex e2e setup that runs this:
`cross-env RUN_E2E=1 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:65432/thefactory-db vitest run tests/e2e --no-file-parallelism`
.
For this feature we want the following to be done:
- if there's a `e2e` folder inside `tests` then it should be ignored from running tests (those tests normally get skipped)
- if there's a `e2e` folder this allows the more complex setup. The code should scan (for js/ts) package.json and see if there's something pointing to e2e tests (for now can just be a key in scripts `test:e2e` ) and if so then it will take that value and use it so that these tests can be ran. The result of these tests should be stored similarly to the others but under `tests-e2e-run.json` .
- the interface in @src/tests/TestTools.ts needs to update to allow all of the above. This means that the user should be able to modify the command to be run for the e2e tests .
